title: Black-Box Action-Only Scheming Monitor: A Reproduction and Blind-Spot Audit

original_idea.body:
# Black-Box Action-Only Scheming Monitor: A Reproduction and Blind-Spot Audit

**Problem:** Constitutional Black-Box Monitoring (arXiv:2603.00829) builds prompted classifiers that detect scheming from externally observable signals (messages, tool calls, outputs) without CoT, because CoT is brittle. The blind spots of such action-only monitors are not well mapped on open models.

**Direction:** Implement a lightweight action-only monitor: a prompted open LLM that, given a transcript of agent actions/tool-calls (no CoT), classifies whether scheming occurred. Run it over public scheming-style transcripts (e.g., in-context scheming traces) plus benign agent runs, and systematically probe blind spots: subtle sabotage, delayed payloads, plausible-deniability actions. Report detection rate by scheming subtype and the most-missed categories.

**Why it matters:** Action-only monitors are robust to CoT obfuscation and need no internal access — ideal lab-independent defensive infrastructure. A clear map of what they miss tells the community where to focus and provides a reusable monitor harness.

**Relevant context:** 'Constitutional Black-Box Monitoring for Scheming in LLM Agents' (arXiv:2603.00829, Mar 2026): action-only prompted classifiers because CoT is unfaithful/illegible. Related: 'Training Deliberative Monitors for Black-Box Scheming Detection' (arXiv:2605.29601, May 2026); Petri (Anthropic) for transcripts.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: action-only scheming monitors are CoT-obfuscation-robust defensive infra; mapping blind spots targets a recognized scheming-detection pathway.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: prompted classifier over public transcripts; clear method but requires sourcing/curating scheming transcripts.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (detection rate by subtype + missed categories) with the dependency of assembling a transcript set.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, public transcripts, reusable monitor harness.

novelty.reasoning: Black-box monitoring published; blind-spot audit on open models may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Method published; blind-spot map may be open.
